text:
maria: Heads-up - I'm opening a docs PR to cover audit export streaming + webhook delivery and to add migration snippets from the batch/export JSON model to the new streaming shape. Need short SDK snippets (Go/Node/Python/Ruby), a CLI example for signed URL downloads, and a legal-approved retention blurb.

sanjay: Streaming shape = events over HTTP chunked with meta headers? Can you paste the shape diff?

maria: Yes: older/export JSON was a single items array; streaming yields newline-delimited JSON (NDJSON) with each object containing audit_event, service.context, and metadata. Also added delivery.webhook_id and export.signed_url for async downloads.

alex: I can produce Go/Node examples for a streaming client and a signed URL fetch. Any constraints on showing signed URL usage?

jen: Legal wants retention described clearly. Suggested wording: "Default retention is 90 days and can be adjusted per customer account. Audit exports created for legal hold or regulatory requests are preserved according to applicable legal requirements." Please use "customer account" rather than "customer".

paul-ops: Ops note: webhook deliveries will include a delivery.signature header; docs should show how to verify HMAC. We'll need a short Ruby snippet for verification. Also call out replayability rules.

sanjay: Draft NDJSON curl example for docs: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.ai/audit/stream?from=2025-09-01T00:00:00Z&to=2025-09-02T00:00:00Z" | jq -c '. | {ts:.timestamp, cat:.audit_event.category, svc:.service.context.name}'`

alex: Go streaming snippet (very short):
```go
// read NDJSON stream
resp, _ := http.Get(streamURL)
scanner := bufio.NewScanner(resp.Body)
for scanner.Scan() {
  var evt map[string]interface{}
  json.Unmarshal(scanner.Bytes(), &evt)
  fmt.Println(evt["audit_event"].(map[string]interface{})["category"])
}
```

alex: Node streaming fetch example: `const stream = await fetch(streamUrl, {headers}); for await (const chunk of stream.body) { /* split by newline, JSON.parse each */ }`

sanjay: Ruby webhook verify example: `signature = request.headers["delivery-signature"]; valid = OpenSSL::HMAC.hexdigest("sha256", secret, body) == signature`

maria: Also include an example export JSON for signed_url downloads showing `export.signed_url`, `export.expires_at`, and a `metadata.legal_hold: true` field.

paul-ops: Add note that signing keys rotate monthly; include link to ops runbook (internal). Tag infra for release coordination.

docs-bot: PR #5179 opened by maria: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/5179

jen: I'll approve the retention sentence once all uses of "customer" are replaced with "customer account." Also confirm we don't leak signed_url in logs by default.

maria: Good catch. I'll add a warning about not logging signed URLs and a QA checklist item to run the streaming examples locally.

alex: I'll push a small commit formatting code fences and adding the Ruby snippet.

sanjay: I'll add a migration table: batch.items[] -> NDJSON per-line object, event_type -> audit_event.category, seq_id -> service.context.seq_id. Also include a jq filter to convert old batch JSON to NDJSON for quick testing.

paul-ops: Ops will coordinate a minor agent bump for webhook headers. Please add changelog and tag release managers.

maria: Thanks team. Plan: ship PR with streaming + webhook docs, SDK snippets, signed URL example, and retention wording. Merge after QA + legal sign-off and infra coordination. :thumbsup:
